input: Four item IDs1–4; integer responses1–5 or explicitmissingnull; reject duplicates,unknownIDs,booleans,nonintegers,out-of-range
formula: Arithmetic mean of both raw responses separately; no reverse coding
missing: If either member missing, that subscale is null. Other complete subscale can display with overall INCOMPLETE notice. No automatic imputation.
authorVersusPlatform: Two-complete-items aggregation is author guidance. Partial-display status and malformed-input rejection are proposed platform rules, not newly claimed author rules.
researchImputation: MI/FIML recommendations concern research data modeling, not filling a person’s missing answers.

structuralEvidence.source_contract: 2022英文版：1、2题内控均分，3、4题外控均分；不反向，不合计。
structuralEvidence.counterevidence_2026: 德国代表性成人样本N=2522，支持包含默许应答倾向方法因子的单内容潜因子模型；普通单因子模型拟合不佳。不是简单四题合计或普通单因子得到支持。
structuralEvidence.no_transfer: 2022 UK/DE仅metric而非scalar invariance，不能据此比较跨国均值，也不能转移为英中等值。
structuralEvidence.interpretation: 为保持2022英文版计分可追溯性保留双均分，2026德语研究提出应答倾向解释，不能宣称两个无争议独立特质。
